meta.source_kind: public JSON API (API Platform, no auth)
meta.key_format: te::{operator settlement id} — prefixed to keep keyspaces of different operators apart
notes: KATOTTG is not published by TOE (codeOtg empty in all 12028 records) — settlements with identical names are distinguishable only by operator id + hromada.
Settlement type (місто/село/смт) is not published by TOE — the 'type' field is empty.
House numbers '1-А' were normalised to '1А'; all other tokens kept verbatim, including non-residential ones (б/н, вул. освітлення, водокачка).
'streets' holds ГПВ queues only. ГАВ queues live in 'gav' — a separate namespace, not a state of the same schedule.

Streets with no houses at all were dropped (218 of 11129): a street cannot be picked without a house behind it, and 175 of them were the source's unnamed 'вул. ' placeholder. Unnamed streets that DO carry houses are kept verbatim - the operator publishes outages under the same string, and renaming them would break address matching.
